title: Anthropic, OpenAI Can Both Win AI Race: T. Rowe Price
title_cn: Anthropic, OpenAI Can Both Win AI Race: T. Rowe Price

Rowe Price partner Emma Norchet says Anthropic is entering “act two” of its growth story, moving beyond its early success in coding toward becoming an AI layer through which businesses can execute entire workflows. With multi-billion-dollar positions in both Anthropic and OpenAI, Norchet explains why T. Rowe Price doesn’t see frontier AI as a winner-take-all market. Norchet discusses where she sees the next opportunities for Anthropic, and why public-market investors will have an appetite for leading AI companies when they choose to IPO. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bender: AI’s ‘Existential’ Risk Is ‘Fake’
title_cn: Bender: AI’s ‘Existential’ Risk Is ‘Fake’

She points to environmental costs, disruption to workers, surveillance, misinformation and chatbot dependence. She argues that incidents involving AI systems accessing outside networks should be viewed as the responsibility of the companies deploying them - not as autonomous models “going rogue.” She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
